## Calmshore
Calmshore is a casual, non-competitive guild with no strict contribution requirements.

We accept players who enjoy relaxed incremental gameplay and want access to basic guild activities and mechanics (raid, challenge, repair maintenance, energizing Pools bonus) without pressure.  

We expect members to participate or contribute at their own pace — every little bit helps.

Joining Requirement: Combat Lv. 50

Due to prolonged non-participation from past members, members are now required to participate in any guild activity at least once every 3 weeks.

Kick: After 4 days of profile inactivity or 3 weeks of guild inactivity.
You will be sent a final notice before being kicked.

Raid: Daily x2 - schedule two hours before raid.  
Skybound Eden (Combat Lv. 70) (55 Minutes) - Floating Gardens of Aetheria

1st Raid: PST 6pm, CST 8pm, EST 9pm, UTC 1am, AWST 9am  
2nd Raid: PST 7am, CST 9am, EST 10am, UTC 2pm, AWST 10pm

Weekly Energizing Pools activated on SAT and SUN (America) after 1st raid.

(Saturday) PST 6:55pm, CST 8:55pm, EST 9:55pm, (Sunday) UTC 1:55am, AWST 9:55am  
(Sunday) PST 6:55pm, CST 8:55pm, EST 9:55pm, (Monday) UTC 1:55am, AWST 9:55am

Our Discord: https://discord.gg/Np2jQR4BCz

Current Goal:  
Complete Guild Challenges to afford weekly Guild Raids & Energizing Pools  
Maintain Repair Material in Stockpile

History:  
20251212 Guild Established, transferred from 'Harem Kings' Guild  
20260403 Completion of Energizing Pools

### | GUILD BOARD |

[GUILD MARKS]  
Each completed Guild Challenge add 1 mark. Guild Marks are used to fund Raids (3 marks per raid) and Energizing Pools (5 marks per activation).

[CONTRIBUTION]  
Contribute at your own pace.  
- Join a raid. (Lv. 70 raid rewards 2.1k gold, 23k Combat EXP, 25k Guild Mastery EXP)
- Contribute to Guild Challenge. We appreciate all the help we can get.
- Repair Material Stockpile. Best to repair guild components as soon as possible - repair cost increases with the degree of deterioration.

### | Posted on 20260608 |

Last Thursday, our guild have reached Lv. 80. This open a Lv. 80 raid at Celestial Observatory. A few members have mentioned that they are willing to wait for other active raiders to catch up. I'll check with these members and we'll announce a date when we are ready.

New raid requires spending of 1 additional guild mark. It put us in a deficit to sustain new raid and 2x Energizing Pools activation per week. My perspective is that: we have enough Guild Marks saved that we can continue with deficit. We'll reach Guild Lv. 85 with +1 guild challenge but that is only enough to support 1 time activation. Eventually, we will have to reduce Energizing Pools activation to a 1x per week, at least until Guild Lv. 100.

Let me know if you have an opinion, either through mail or Discord. Otherwise, this is probably what we'll do as we have a total of 260+ Guild mark and we should spend it.

Welcome our new members, Przebiegly, Dreadchaos!

Last week Contributors, thanks for filling up our guild mark coffer.
